text: One of the worst experiences with any application. If you don't want to read the whole commet, read at least my recommendation (based on my experience): YOU DON'T HAVE TO BUY THE PREMIUM VERSION, they have a free version as well. And also TRY THE APP FOR MORE THAN A MONTH BEFORE YOU BUY IT (MORE THAN JUST THE FIRST CHALLENGE). I downloaded the app with the hope that it would help me change and help with my anxiety, but ended up feeling very deluded and tricked into buying it. You have to enter the card number right at the beginning and they will automatically download an extremely expensive annual subscription after a week. It seemed like there is no free version (you can try for a week and than you have to pay) but there actualy is, they just don't present it in the app... I wanted to try the application, I really trusted it. But I ran into a lot of problems - really bad navigation, the challenges I tried had unclear tasks, which caused me more anxiety for not being able to do them. The application does not distinguish between tasks on weekdays and weekends, it does not allow you to stop tasks, for example, when you are ill or on vacation. The notifications randomly stopped working. For me, the visualisation of progress wasn't satysfying or motivating me to do more. It was a big disappointment and after fulfilling the first challenge (for me the only useful one) and the next month, when I tried to work with the application, I gave it up. For me the saddest part is that the "google award winning app" which should "reduce stress and anxiety, increase mindfulness and a lot more" makes profit on not giving clear information and only allows to subscribe annualy (no other options like monthly subscriptions), so even if the app doesn't suit you (or help you), you've wasted a considerable amount of money for the remaining subscription time. So for me: Not fabulous at all.
